evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic reports lower token use on comparable outcomes, which is material counterevidence to a universal increase. Company evaluations do not establish average production spending or company-wide losses.

evidence_items.locator: Efficient reasoning across tasks, Adaptive reasoning
evidence_items.explanation: This is direct counterevidence for straightforward tasks. The same announcement describes more persistent reasoning on difficult tasks, so the direction of costs depends on workload and settings.

The paper supports the narrower mechanism that verbose reasoning can increase token costs. It also studies ways to reduce that overhead; it does not measure startup losses or venture-capital consumption.
